bio: Please note from 8th November - 30th December 2023 only the Festive Afternoon Tea will be served. Please click here for more information.  Middle Eight offers the opportunity to enjoy the most noble of traditions in a contemporary setting.  Delight in their new musically inspired Afternoon Tea, which celebrates the hotel's affinity with music.  Located in the heart of theatreland, Middle Eight provides the perfect backdrop for the experience, with its harmonious blend of beautiful design, timeless luxury and eclectic soundtrack.  The menu includes a host of delicate delights with decorative and musical touches: ‘ Blood Orange Opera’ - citrus Pannacotta with layers of blood orange jelly; ‘ Treble Clef Treat’ - silky smooth and delicate Pistachio macaron filled with buttercream & roasted praline; and crispy, creamy ‘Hazelnut Harmony’ – Clanny’s twist on the classic Hazelnut éclair.  Choose from a range of fine fair trade tea or freshly brewed artisan coffee and pair it with a glass of Prosecco to make things extra special.  Afternoon Tea is served in the the restaurant, where you can watch the world go by.  Available Wednesday to Sunday from 1pm to 5pm.
